moduleGrid.heading: Seven modules, one control surface
moduleGrid.lede: Every module reads from the same event and session model, so nothing needs to be wired together manually on event day.

items.title: Live Q&A
items.copy: Attendees submit questions from their phone; moderators approve, reject, or push them to the big screen.

items.title: Keypad Voting
items.copy: Instant multiple-choice polls with live, animated result bars visible to the whole room.

items.title: Screen Management
items.copy: One operator board drives the projector — swap between question, poll, and break states in a click.

items.title: Survey
items.copy: Post-session feedback forms with rating, text, single-choice and dropdown questions, aggregated live.

items.title: Analytics
items.copy: Every question, vote and response rolls up into a per-session results view you can export.

items.title: Speaker Management
items.copy: Assign a speaker and hall to every session, so the schedule stays accurate as the day changes.

items.title: Schedule
items.copy: A single source of truth for sessions across halls, tracks and days — attendees always see what's live.

items.name: Congresses & Conferences
items.copy: Multi-track, multi-day programs where session-level engagement data needs to roll up into one event-wide picture.

items.name: Hybrid & Online
items.copy: Remote and in-room attendees share the same join code, the same question queue, and the same stage screen.

items.name: Corporate Summits
items.copy: Town-halls and internal kickoffs where leadership needs a live pulse on sentiment, not just a Q&A inbox.

items.name: Academic Symposiums
items.copy: Peer-reviewed sessions with live Q&A and post-talk surveys tied to each speaker slot.

featureDeepDive.heading: Four moves, one live loop

items.title: Every question, ranked by the room
items.copy: Attendees submit questions from their own device. The audience upvotes what matters, moderators triage in one queue, and a single click sends the top question straight to the stage screen.

items.title: Keypad voting, without the hardware
items.copy: Launch a poll, watch votes land in real time as animated bars, and close it the moment the room has spoken. No clickers to hand out or collect.

items.title: Feedback that compiles itself
items.copy: Rating, text, single-choice and dropdown questions in one survey. Responses aggregate live, so you're reading results before the coffee break ends.

items.title: The projector is just another client
items.copy: The stage screen listens on the same channel as the operator board. Switch between question, poll, and break states and it updates in under a second, everywhere.

plans.discountNote: Need more than your plan's yearly quota? Extra events are ₼59 each — no need to upgrade.

faqs.q: How does the yearly event quota work?
faqs.a: Each plan includes a fixed number of events for the year — for example, Growth includes 8. There's no daily rate: a three-day congress and a single-day workshop each count as just one event against your quota.

faqs.q: What if I need more events than my plan includes?
faqs.a: Add extra events any time, at a flat ₼59 each — no need to upgrade your whole plan just to cover a busier month.

faqs.q: Can I change plans partway through the year?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrading unlocks the extra modules and event quota immediately, and we prorate the price difference for the months remaining in your plan year.

faqs.q: Do attendees need to download anything?
faqs.a: No. Attendees join with a code from any phone's browser — there's no app install and no account to create.

faqs.q: Can I run more than one event on the same account?
faqs.a: Yes — each event gets its own join code, sessions and Operator Board, all managed from one organizer account.

faqs.q: What's included after my event ends?
faqs.a: Every question, poll result and survey response stays available to export as CSV for as long as your account exists.
